title: Normal Beer
description: A joke texture pack meant to be used with the [Let's Do] Brewery mod
body:
Have YOU seen the funny haha twitter "adult comedy show" The New Norm?

Are you ironically attatched to it because of how genuinely terrible it is?

Do you think wish the funny woke beer can could be in the [Let's Do] Brewery mod? 

Well do I have just the thing for you! This texture pack replaces all beer items/models in the mod with a rainbow beer can from the funny show. You're welcome ;)

If theres any issues you can DM me [here](https://bsky.app/profile/thegayestvivian.bsky.social)
